Subject: New vendor: bank letters + remit sample (Acelera)

Hi Rishi / Jonas,

Thanks for the quick onboarding window. Attached are the KYC docs we were asked for (W9) and the bank letter from First Harbor Bank confirming routing and account ownership. I also attached a small sample CSV with the remit string layout we send on our invoices so you can test field mapping on your side.

Quick notes:
- Bank: First Harbor Bank (ACH & Wires enabled)
- Account: Acelera Logistics LLC — operating account for payables
- Remit sample columns: invoice_number | po_number | remit_reference | net_amount | tax_amount

We usually include PO in column 2; occasionally customers send PO in the invoice header instead of the line items. If you need a special prefix or a different delimiter, let us know.

Attachments: W9_Acelera_2026.pdf, Acelera_BankLetter_20261013.pdf, remit_sample_20261013.csv

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if any of the fields look off.

Regards,

Subject: Re: New vendor: bank letters + remit sample (Acelera)

Hi Asha — thanks for sending these over and for the CSV sample. A couple quick clarifying items from our side so we can move this into Finance intake: 

1) Remit mapping: can you confirm whether the "remit_reference" column is guaranteed to contain only alphanumeric characters (no pipes or commas)? We prefer an ASCII-safe field for automated matching.
2) PO behavior: when you say "occasionally customers send PO in the invoice header", does the CSV include both the invoice header and line-level PO? If not, can you add an optional sample row that shows a header-level PO?
3) Bank letter: looks good; Finance will require a bank-letter letterhead and a dated signature. Is the attached PDF signed and dated 2026-10-13?

Next steps on our side: Marissa (cc'd) will run the file through our payee intake checklist and kick off a micro-deposit/ACH verification next week. Once that completes we'll request clearance for the first wire if you need same-day settlement.

Can you reply with a one-line confirmation to the three items above? If preferred, we can schedule a 20-min call tomorrow to finish intake.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Hi Rishi — quick replies inline: 

1) remit_reference: correct — alphanumeric only (we strip punctuation at generation), so safe for automated matching.
2) PO behavior: our standard CSV is invoice-level. I attached a one-row example showing a header-level PO as requested (remit_sample_20261013.csv now includes a header_PO example).
3) Bank letter: yes, the attached bank-letter is signed and dated 2026-10-13 by the account manager at First Harbor.

We can do a call but seems like the clarifications should be sufficient to get micro-deposits started. Let us know when Marissa has set the verification window.

Thanks,
Asha

Hi Asha — thanks for the quick confirmations and for the updated sample. I finished the intake checklist this afternoon. Summary / next steps: 

- Bank verification: scheduled for MON 2026-10-19 — we'll initiate micro-deposits (ACH) and email you the two test amounts when posted. Please confirm account access or expected timeframe for checking the micro-deposits after initiation.
- PO mapping: we will map invoice_number -> invoice_number, po_number -> PO field (header-level is supported). We'll treat remit_reference as a free-text match key (alphanumeric only) for reconciliation.
- Wire fallback: if ACH fails, please confirm whether you accept wires to the same account (we saw wire routing in the bank letter but want explicit approval).
- Finance contact: Jonas (cc) will be the day-to-day for the payment. Once micro-deposits clear we'll create the vendor in our AP system and schedule first payable.

Can you reply with: (a) confirmation that wires are accepted to the same account and (b) the expected window to read micro-deposits (e.g., 24-48 hours)? Once we get that we'll proceed.

Thanks — small housekeeping: could you also upload the signed bank letter to the DocuSign link above so we have a central record?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Finance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
